notes.note: #0.123-#0.136 are unused alternates of the #0.122 grunt (0731.bla only shows TextIdOffset+121 = #0.122); kept identical to the established 'Guoh...'.
Speaker Ultraman Belial verified (MessWinSet 136, CHARA_NAME 141). Contemptuous -yagaru rendered 'Damn them'; 'they' = the party.

0731.bla: leader id r0 set by the 2nd Pt_Chara_Check sequence; ids 1 Rider 1, 2 RX, 3 Den-O, 4 W, 5 OOO, 6 Nu, 7 Zeta, 8 God, 9 Wing Zero, 10 00, 11 Ultraman, 12 Seven, 13 Taro, 14 Mebius, 15 Zero. Block MessWinSet 137+k (#0.138-152) order: Zero, OOO, Mebius, W, Taro, Den-O, Seven, RX, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. Wording matches (rough #0.138 Zero, #0.141 W, #0.143 Momotaros; 'boku' #0.140 Mebius). I/boku/watashi 'we' variants collapse to the same English.
OOO variant: 'so as not to lose to evil' instead of 'not forgive evil'.
Den-O leader takes a separate branch: #0.143 (Den-O), then Kintaros #0.172 + #0.184, Ryutaros #0.173, Den-O #0.196. Extracted labels on #0.172/#0.173/#0.184/#0.196 are correct.

Pair block MessWinSet 153+2k/154+2k (#0.154-183), order: 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, OOO (#0.160-161), W (#0.162-163), Zero, Zeta, RX, God, Den-O slot (#0.172-173 = Kintaros/Ryutaros lines, Den-O branch only), Rider 1, Nu, Taro, Seven, Ultraman. Slice '?party' labels on #0.154/#0.155 fine; identical Japanese kept identical. Sentence split at the row boundary as in the source.
OOO. Subject of 'tomete miseru' unstated; rendered 'I'm going to' (speaker's own resolve).
W (Shotaro) only. Trails off; the script follows it directly with #0.192 ('I'll be the one who stops you... No, we will.'), since W gets one row from the third block instead of two.

Third block MessWinSet 185+2k/186+2k (#0.186-215), order: Zero, OOO (#0.188-189, Eiji's reach-out creed), Mebius, W (#0.192 only; #0.193 never shown), Taro, Den-O slot (#0.196-197; Den-O branch shows only #0.196, #0.197 never shown), Seven, RX, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. Slice '?party' on #0.186/#0.187 = Zero's pair.
Eiji's creed; phrasing follows the earlier rendering in 0108 #0.21 with a generic 'you'.
Subject of 'iya da' unstated; 'we' to match the 'we reach out' clause.
Momotaros-voiced alternate, never displayed by 0731.bla; translated anyway.
Ultraman Belial (MessWinSet 215, CHARA_NAME 141). 'Taishita rikutsu' is sarcastic: 'Quite the argument'.

report: All 80 rows verified against 0731.bla leader-index tables. Unused rows: #0.135-136 (grunt alternates), #0.193, #0.197. OOO #0.161 subject 'I' inferred. No new names.
